assets.note: ONE image for every product, not one per flavor — the Uses section is about how the snack is eaten, which does not change with the flavor. Keep the fruit plain golden and unseasoned so it reads as any pouch in the range. The serving props, not the fruit, are the subject.
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: portrait photograph for the 'Uses' section of a premium Thai dried mango product page. An unhurried breakfast-table scene on a warm cream limestone counter: a small ivory ceramic bowl of plain golden dried mango strips in the foreground, a bowl of thick plain yoghurt topped with a few chopped strips beside it, and a clear glass cup of jasmine tea and a folded natural linen napkin set behind. The fruit is plain sun-dried mango with a wrinkled chewy texture and no visible seasoning, coating, chili or colouring. Soft directional morning daylight from the left, restrained editorial food styling, cream and golden amber palette, realistic natural shadows, shallow depth of field on the background props. Three-quarter view, arrangement centred with generous breathing room, portrait 4:5 composition that also crops cleanly to 16:11. No people, hands, packaging, lettering, logos, watermark or collage.
